  • new InvalidConstruction line 23
public static function listOf<T of object>(
    array<array-key, object|array<array-key, object|scalar|null>|scalar|null> $items,
    class-string<T> $class,
    string $message,
    int $minimum = 0,
): ($minimum is positive-int ? non-empty-list<T> : list<T>)
source§

Narrows a constructor argument to an ordered list of one class, rejecting anything else.

PHP does not check array element types, so every list a constructor accepts passes through here whatever its PHPDoc promises.

Parameters

$itemsarray<array-key, object|array<array-key, object|scalar|null>|scalar|null>
$classclass-string<T>
$messagestring
$minimumint

Returns

($minimum is positive-int ? non-empty-list<T> : list<T>)

Throws

InvalidConstruction When the argument is not a list of that class, or is shorter than the minimum
